I spent five minutes working together with @14102184337 to interface with Mitale who provides legal services in Brazil

This is my coming handy when we start into facing more deeply with the indigenous for the project that @557191035605 is leading <This message was edited>

Spent 30 minutes facetime with @14102184337 and @557391090002 and Mitale and Renato to discuss the following

- Renato to setup visit to Sugar mill in Sao Paulo
- ⁠Renato’s exporting company CNPJ details
- ⁠Renato’s exporting company’s DUNS number application
- Renato’s ⁠Freighting forwarding company details from Sao Paulo to San Francisco
- ⁠Renato’s Freighting forwarding company details from Belem to San Francisco <This message was edited>
Spent 30 minutes with @14153000019 on the FaceTime call he just mentioned above 🫡😎

Spent 30 minutes on Facetime with @14102184337 Robert discussing about APEX program where all expenses incurred in expanding Brazil’s export to USA qualifies for 20% reimbursement from the Brazilian government.

*Follow up steps*

- compile the list of all prior contributions associated with Agroverse guild in relationship to the setting up of the Brazilian supply chain into USA and then submitting them

- set up periodic submission of contributions associated with Agroverse guild in relationships to the setting up of the Brazilian supply chain into USA and then submitting them

_PS: something interesting to explore is reimbursement for the man hours that were contributed by DAO members to setup this piece of infrastructure and then utilizing this reimbursement to back the value of our TDG / USDT exchange rate on the LATOKEN token exchange_


Thanks for helping setup the meeting @14102184337


https://www.apexbrasil.com.br/en/startups-program <This message was edited>
@14102184337 Spent 15 minutes between June 6 and 7 2023 on initial contact with KetoBric
@14102184337 Another 15 minutes on a follow up on October 9th 2023
@14102184337 10 minutes on further communication through Instagram comments that resulted in that direct message from KetoBrick on April 24 2024 asking for my email.
Spent about 45 minutes between April 24th and April 27th on e-mail communications with Robert Sikes.
Spent 50 minutes on an initial Zoom Call with Robert about the cooperative and the possibility of sourcing cacao butter from Bahia, Brazil

Spent 3 hours total between meetings and dinners on May 11th when Robert and Crystal came to Colorado to meet my family and we discussed importing cacao from Brazil, broker contact and a possible trip to Brazil in the near future.

Spent 5 hours total in calls with @557391090002 between May11th and July 10th which was the period after Robert’s visit on May 11th and right before we left to Brazil on July 13th. Those calls were to coordinate sample status, itinerary for the Brazil visit and sourcing possibilities within Coopercabruca
I spent $1,713.50 US dollars on my roadtrip plane ticket to Brazil to take Robert to meet the cooperative operations.

Spent 50 hours total (averaging 5 working hours per day) on a 10 day trip to Ilhéus to take Robert and his marketing employee Chip to meet the local cacao industry and the possibility of sourcing butter from Brazil. I left the United Stated on July 13th 2024 and landed back on July 22nd 2024.

Spent 5 minutes collecting current prices and brands available of cacao products at my local grocery store in Durango, Colorado. I could only find one brand that had nibs, powder and butter available.
Spent 20 minutes on calls with Dany between last night and this morning about a sample from São Paulo that left on the way to Robert in Arkansas this morning.
Spent 2 minutes updating Robert on the status of the sample and shipping costs.

I spent 60 minutes on a google meets call with the APEX agent to understand better what they offer and how that would benefit TrueSight and Agroverse. They reimburse 20% on all initiatives that strengthen the exports of good from Brazil to other countries.
Spent another 10 minutes explaining to Gary about the APEX initiative and how we could benefit from it and getting information to set up a further meeting with his participation.
Spent 20 minutes on a phone call with a contact that will connect us with sugar suppliers.
Spent 15 minutes updating Gary on my efforts to find a sugar supplier and possible tax law help for Agroverse if needed.
Spent 10 minutes creating a WhatsApp group and introducing Mitale to Gary for tax legal services in Brazil and supplier for the sugar demand.
Spent 15 minutes coordinating an online meeting between Mitale, Gary,  myself and one of the possible suppliers for the sugar demand.

Spent 10 minutes explaining my time availability for a meeting with the APEX agent that will include Gary and Robert so they can understand better how they can get 20% back from federal government for their companies because they’re are exporting goods from Brazil. Once I can coordinate time with them I will check Gary and Rogert’s availability. <This message was edited>
Spent 5 minutes on the Agroverse Chanel proposing a different approach for Durango, Colorado sales strategy.
Spent 5 minutes back in sept 20th going through supplier demands for the cacao butter for KetoBrick
Spent 30 minutes crafting letter of intent to meet this supplier’s demand.
Spent 5 minutes on sept 23rd updating the girls on new structure for purchasing the cacao butter which will facilitate the transaction once we find the supplier

Spent 10 minutes today catching up on the cacao butter supplier.
The girls informed me that their contact person has been through an accident and that’s what’s causing the delayed communications. They are working with his assistant and I have requested in audios that we work on a sample.
I have also requested the location of this supplier for a possible visit by Gary.

Spent 35 minutes total interacting with Emelin to meet her request for help with today’s post on the Agroverse page on Instagram. Post has been made and I have invited Gary, Val and myself as collaborators.

Spent 5 minutes fixing Agroverse Instagram post. Agroverse page is not able to post reels over 1 minute yet. Not knowing that I posted the reels as a reel and just realized it cut the end. For videos longer than 1 minute it needs to go through as a POST rather than a REEL. It ends up in the reels page anyways. Just Instagram stuff 😮💨

This has been fixed 🫡
Spent 2 minutes promoting Agroverse on social media.

Spend 10 minutes receiving sugar supplier information and getting updates on cacao butter supplier.

For the cacao butter, the contact person has been at an accident and we’re trying to get with someone else in the company.
I spent 3 minutes posting the reel on the Agroverse page and making sure to meet all the requirements and settings for that post.
Spent 7 minutes explaining to @557191035605 my intentions of distributing the Agroverse brand.
I spent 30 minutes going through all @557191035605 messages regarding her conflict with @557391090002 and responding to her considerations.
Spent 1 minute researching current cacao nib prices at local store.
Milena (_introduced by @557391090002_) spent 5 minutes making and sharing this Instagram story
I spent 5 minutes reaching out to Milena to  seek her aid with sourcing of quotations from vendors based in Brazil periodically as the occasion arises
Milena spent 5 minutes responding positively to this request
Me and Milena spent 5 minutes discussing about the caramelized cacao almonds
